decisions.reason: The Small Block mechanism is independently specified, and its same-message MODIFY already records its approximately 500-sale trigger and funding from primary and secondary sales.
The FAQ's same-message INTRODUCE already presents the updated Big Block frequency and mint-and-secondary funding semantics, so no additional candidate state change is needed.
The candidate already routes secondary-sale royalties to both prize pools, and changing the Big Block draw trigger does not alter royalty enforcement or allocation.
The candidate's same-message introduction already allocates primary-mint revenue to both prize pools; the Big Block trigger clarification does not change that allocation.
Eligible sale types and pool funding determine when the Big Block draw occurs, not how winners are selected through Chainlink VRF or weighted tickets.
The Big Block trigger and funding clarification does not change referral-ticket issuance, independent counters, eligibility windows, or post-draw resets.
Changing which sales count toward and fund the Big Block draw does not alter the one-click prize-claim flow or Winners page location.
The Big Block draw-trigger and pool-funding decision does not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, or wallet requirements.
The Big Block remains active, so its ticket counter remains valid; the changed draw trigger and funding sources do not require a metadata attribute change.
The Big Block trigger and funding clarification does not affect badge milestones, storage, icons, or current badge effects.
The source Event changes the Big Block draw trigger and pool funding; it does not explicitly modify the separately defined no-referral random reward allocation.
The deferred Discord community-server requirement is unrelated to Big Block draw eligibility or prize-pool funding.
